title: Theology begins from God — He is its chief object
source_text: I. Ut Deus nomen Theologiae dedit, ita ejus est praecipuum objectum. Idcirco res Theologicas tractare aggredienti ab ipso Deo sumendum est exordium.
pass_a_gloss: As God gave the name to Theology, so He is its chief object. Therefore one who sets out to treat theological matters must take the beginning from God Himself.
pass_b_english: Theology takes its name from God — and He is its chief object.
So the right start for theological work is God Himself.
